description: Erection of rear dormer extension,  new rooflights to front roof slope
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture. 


REASON: To preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area.

<p>The two front roof lights, hereby approved, shall be conservation-type only and shall be flush with the front roof slope.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: To preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area.</p>

<p>Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details and full specifications of at least 1 bird and 1 bat box shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and shall be maintained for the lifespan of the development. The details should include:</p><ul><li style="margin-left: 15px;">A minimum of 1 bird box incorporated into the design of the development, with a variety of box types (including different sized entrance holes) to provide habitat for diverse bird species. The boxes should be installed at or close to the eaves level of the development hereby approved. The boxes should be between 3 and 5 metres from the ground, and there should be a clear flight path without any obstructions below and directly in front of the box. The boxes should be facing north, east or north east (direct sunlight should be avoided), and should not be placed immediately above doors or windows.&nbsp;<i>Boxes located in the same area should not be placed too close together.&nbsp;</i></li><li style="margin-left: 15px;">A minimum of 1 bat box incorporated into the design of the development. Boxes should be placed at or close to the eaves level of the development and at least 4m above the ground. The boxes should be placed away from artificial light sources and i<i>deally located near dark tree lines or hedgerows where possible.&nbsp;</i>The boxes should be located facing south, southeast or southwest, and exposed to sun for part of the day.</li></ul><p>REASON:&nbsp;To support bird and bat populations, including swifts, in Hackney and preserve endangered urban&nbsp;<span class="il">biodiversity</span>, by providing nesting opportunities.</p><div><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;"></div>
